benchmark_qknorm_performance: benchmark qknorm performance across head_dim, GQA, kv_heads, and batch_size for multiple providers
run_sgl_aot_qknorm: run SGL AOT qknorm with async CUDA streams for q and k rmsnorm operations
run_sgl_jit_qknorm: run SGL JIT fused qknorm in-place on q and k tensors with weight normalization
run_flashinfer_qknorm: run FlashInfer rmsnorm separately on q and k tensors with per-tensor weights
run_torch_qknorm: run torch-compiled qknorm using mean-of-squares rmsnorm with in-place copy
